name: Calendar
description: The Tamrielic calendar, months, weekdays, seasonal rhythms, and festive holidays of The Elder Scrolls: Arena

entries.content: Morning Star: The first month of the year, bringing freezing blizzards across the northern provinces. Marked by the New Life Festival where citizens toast to renewal and hope for the coming cycle.

Sun's Dawn: The second month of the year, characterized by persistent frost and bitter mountain winds. Celebrated mid-month with Heart's Day, a festive tradition of hospitality, romance, and sharing hearth warmth.
First Seed: The herald of early spring. Mountain snows begin thawing and farmers sow their first crops during the First Planting holiday as merchants reopen mountain trade passes.
Rain's Hand: A month of torrential downpours and blooming flora across Tamriel. Marked near its close by Jester's Day, when pranks and bawdy theatricals fill public squares.
Second Seed: Late spring in full bloom, offering temperate skies and bustling trade. Farmers celebrate the Second Planting, giving thanks to the Eight Divines for fertile loam.
Midyear: The dawn of high summer with long, sunlit days. Citizens and temple orders gather on the Midyear Celebration to honor the Divines with sacred hymns, tournaments, and feasts.

Sun's Height: Peak summer heat across Tamriel, where desert sands bake and jungle canopies hum with life. Commemorated by the Merchant's Festival, when guilds lower prices and trade caravans flourish.
Last Seed: The close of summer and the beginning of harvest time. Harvest's End is observed across villages with cider pressing, dancing, and grand feasts before autumn winds arrive.

Hearthfire: The first month of autumn, when leaves turn gold and amber. On Tales and Tallows, citizens gather in taverns around roaring fires to recount ghost stories and legendry of ancient necromancers.

Frostfall: A chilly autumn month where morning frost coats roofs and roads. Marked by the Witches' Festival, a night when magical covens commune with otherworldly spirits and alchemists trade potent tinctures.
Sun's Dusk: The darkening dusk of the year, bringing early twilight and cold winds. South Wall's Day is celebrated with spirited tavern gatherings and charity for the destitute.
Evening Star: The final month of the year, locking Tamriel in snow and ice. Observed with North Wind's Prayer for winter survival and culminating on its final night with the Old Life Festival.

Days of the Week: Tamriel follows a seven-day week structured as Morndas, Tirdas, Middas, Turdas, Fredas, Loredas, and Sundas. Sundas is dedicated to temple worship, while Fredas and Loredas see lively tavern trade.

The Imperial Simulacrum (3E 389): The dark decade during which the Battlemage Jagar Tharn secretly imprisoned Emperor Uriel Septim VII in an alternate realm, ruling the Empire with an iron fist through illusion and sorcery.
